_comment: Cross-language shlex round-trip golden fixture — GSO wire v1 (issue #161).
CONTRACT for #162: Go has NO stdlib shlex quoter. #162's encoder MUST emit,
for each case's `tokens` (the 5 positional request fields in order:
[text, ref_audio_path, prompt_text, text_split_method, voice_id]), a wire
line that shlex.split's back to exactly `tokens`. The `wire` field here is
Python shlex.quote's canonical output; byte-identical output is sufficient
but NOT required — round-trip equality (split(wire)==tokens) is the contract.
The Python worker (scripts/gptsovits_worker.py) shlex.split's the wire line
and requires exactly 5 tokens. No token may contain a newline or CR.

tokens: replicas set to three, then restart
cases.wire: 'replicas set to three, then restart' /m/cool-jahns-gso/ref_audio.wav 'This is my reference clip.' cut4 cool-jahns-gso

tokens: run $(rm -rf /) now; echo `whoami` | cat > out & star *
cases.wire: 'run $(rm -rf /) now; echo `whoami` | cat > out & star *' /r.wav 'meta chars < > | ; & $ ` * ? [ ]' cut4 cool-jahns-gso
'hello world' '/my models/cool jahns/ref audio.wav' 'prompt with spaces' cut4 cool-jahns-gso
'café naïve résumé — 日本語 🎙' /r.wav 'prompt café 日本語' cut4 cool-jahns-gso
